assumptions: C1 rule 3 (export prefix) is applied after trimming leading whitespace, so '  export A=1' yields key A; 'export=1' (no following space/tab) yields key 'export'
A line that is only 'export ' followed by whitespace becomes empty after removal and yields problem missing '=' (rule 4), not a skip
Non-string input is coerced with String(text) so parseEnv never throws (INV-04); C1 types the input as string
